items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: The bass player that was with us with J. C. Heard on that record with Doc Cheatham was Carl Pruitt.

ctx.x: you know, been a very, very prominent person in that...in Television and Radio and all that. But I declined because I knew that I wasn't equipped.
The bass player that was with us with J. C. Heard on that record with Doc Cheatham was Carl Pruitt.
Oh yeah, yeah. But you did do quite a lot of things in Philadelphia...that thing, uh, what was it called?
